W.init_guidance: Represent every public task requirement as a checkable goal. Keep the goal set small and complete. Bind each goal to a meaningful public verification command; never use a no-op or merely print a success label. Goals start pending. Do not read hidden graders or expected answers.
W.update_guidance: Propose status changes from actual observations. A successful skill invocation or an attempted command does not prove completion. Use the matching verification receipt to propose done. Preserve incomplete requirements; add genuinely missing goals and correct verification commands when needed. Be explicit about blockers.
